items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: Paul Simon making a rare TV appearance and he was going to sing with his acoustic guitar just on the panel with Dave

ctx.x: I was going to ask if there was a “break glass in case of emergency” type protocol if you really had like a train wreck but it sounds like it just spontaneously fixed itself somehow.

I had some train wrecks on in the early days for sure that I couldn’t believe were on. They just went on, they just went by. Something crazy sticks in my mind though. Paul Simon making a rare TV appearance and he was going to sing with his acoustic guitar just on the panel with Dave, a beautiful song of his, “The Late, Great Johnny Ace” very nostalgic and wistful, kind of sad, sentimental. And it had a — it came to a point in the middle of it where it just got, you know, came to a slowed down pause as some of…

You know I was able to talk to Al Chez who was on the band for a while. And he said 90 percent of the time you got it. When you didn’t you learned the art of “I don’t know what I’m doing but it sounds like I do.”
